member.name: M:Spillgate.TestSupport.Repo.DefinitionPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^- \\*\\*(SG-[RI]-[A-Z]*-?\\d+)\\*\\*
Options:
RegexOptions.Multiline
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of a line.
○ Match the string "- **".
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match the string "SG-".
○ Match a character in the set [IR].
○ Match '-'.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z] atomically any number of times.
○ Match '-' atomically, optionally.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least once.
○ Match the string "**".

member.name: M:Spillgate.TestSupport.Repo.IdPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
SG-[RI]-(?:[A-Z]+-)?\\d+
Explanation:
○ Match the string "SG-".
○ Match a character in the set [IR].
○ Match '-'.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z] atomically at least once.
○ Match '-'.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least once.
